Set creates or updates a task in the repository.

Content can be provided directly as an argument or read from a file using -f.
When using -f, the content is stored in the database (not just the path).

Usage:
  agent task set <name> [content] [flags]

Examples:
  agent task set research-auth "Analyze the authentication patterns in internal/auth"
  agent task set research-auth -f tasks/research-auth.md

Flags:
  -f, --file string   Read content from file
  -h, --help          help for set

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
